Job Title: 		Baker
Salary range: 	$79,500 - $85,000
Job Closure date:30 days

About This Role:
Our client is a beloved artisan bakery renowned for its commitment to traditional baking techniques and high-quality, handcrafted products. With a passion for creating delicious, wholesome breads, pastries, and desserts, they take pride in using time-honoured methods and premium ingredients to deliver exceptional baked goods to their community.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Baker to join their dedicated team. In this role, you will be responsible for crafting a variety of artisanal breads, pastries, and desserts while maintaining the highest standards of quality, consistency, and food safety. The ideal candidate will have a strong work ethic, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for the art of baking.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Production & Baking:
• Prepare, mix, knead, and shape dough using traditional methods to create artisanal bread, rolls, and pastries.
• Monitor fermentation and proofing processes to ensure optimal texture and flavour development.
• Carefully load, bake, and unload products, adjusting oven temperatures and baking times for perfect results.

Quality Control & Preparation:
• Inspect raw ingredients for freshness and accuracy, measuring and weighing components to exact specifications.
• Taste-test and evaluate product consistency, adjusting techniques as needed to maintain high standards.

Equipment & Workspace Maintenance:
• Conduct thorough checks of baking equipment and work areas before production to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.
• Clean, grease, and maintain baking trays, tins, and machinery to uphold hygiene and operational efficiency.
• Operate dough mixers, rollers, and cutting machines safely, ensuring proper handling and maintenance.

Skills & Requirements:
• Proven 1- 2 years’ full-time experience as a Baker in an artisanal or commercial bakery setting.
• Qualification Certificate III in Baking or above
• Strong knowledge of baking techniques, fermentation, and dough handling.
• Ability to work early mornings, weekends, and holidays as required.
• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality products.
• Understanding of food safety standards and hygiene best practices.
• Physical stamina to stand for long periods and handle heavy baking equipment.

If you are passionate about traditional baking and thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to be part of a team that takes pride in crafting exceptional baked goods with care and expertise.

Please note: We are acting as the recruitment agent on behalf of our client, and the employer’s identity will be disclosed upon application.

result.description:
About us

We’re not like other digital marketing companies.

We are a consulting-led agency. What does that mean? It means our sole focus is driving profitable growth for our client’s business.
It means we are platform and channel-agnostic. We look at where clients want to go and tell them the best way to get there, even if that means taking a road less travelled.

We work with some of the world’s best-known companies, including innovative scale-ups, large global brands and private equity firms, to deliver visionary yet pragmatic solutions to their unique challenges.

We (and our clients!) consider us experts in: media buying & advertising, creative, SEO, social media management, content, web analytics & attribution, website development, conversion rate optimization and UX/ UI consulting. We use our expertise and skills to help our clients drive fast profitable growth for their business.

We service clients in Australia and the US with most of us based in our Sydney office and some key team members working remotely around the world. We are currently operating on a hybrid model with Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office.

Our company culture is one of innovation, diversity and excellence. Most importantly, we genuinely care about each other, which makes working at Orange Line that much better!


About the role

Reporting to the Paid Media Manager, the Senior Paid Media Executive will help look after
our high-growth client portfolio.

You will specifically be involved in delivering cutting-edge strategies across a spectrum of
paid channels such as Search, Social, Programmatic, Lead Generation & Mobile, with a focus
on optimising results. Reporting will also be a big part of the role, so numbers shouldn’t faze
you.

This is the perfect opportunity if you’re looking to gain hands-on experience in digital
marketing whilst working with prestigious clients, and essentially broaden your skillset and
learn the execution of new channels.

You will be responsible for

- Management of digital campaigns including setup, reporting & optimisation
- Support managers at client weekly meetings and present key learnings and action items
- Management of existing accounts & campaigns, with best practice application, budget management, reconciliation and testing
- Delivery of campaign reporting with the support of our reporting specialists
- Provide insight, analysis and guidance to client and team on campaign optimisation and opportunities
- Use of 3rd party tools including Bid Management platforms and Ad Servers
- Create media plans and provide spend forecasts
- Liaise with 3rd party providers to resolve any issues as they arise
- Proactively contribute to team meetings & knowledge sharing


About you

- 3+ years’ experience in Paid Search or Paid Social is crucial
- Experience across other paid channels is desired but not essential
- Reporting / analytical - comfortable with numbers and data
- Strong skill set across Microsoft Excel
- Experience working on performance-focused clients is desired but not essential
- Confidence & proven results in implementing optimisations to drive the desired outcome
- Clear communicator and innovative thinker
- Commitment to staying ahead of industry trends & an eagerness to learn
- Logical and analytical approach to problem-solving
- Effective and efficient working style
- Take pride in your work and care about the people around you because we are a family-oriented agency


What's in it for you

- Awesome office located 15 minutes walk to/from Central Station
- Orange Line is a company that believes in work/life harmony and flexibility
- Permanent hybrid model with Mon/Wed/Fri working from home and Tue/Thu in the office
- You will receive excellent avenues for learning & development. We set clear goals and milestones: so when we grow, you grow.
- You will work with a mix of brands and industries here in Australia and internationally
- Work alongside subject-matter experts who've been working at that level for years, giving you breadth of knowledge and experience
- Monthly organised social events, like brewery tours, boat parties, cheese making - and maybe you can suggest the next one!
- We are super inclusive and are open to everyone and everything. Have a say in the team, the culture, and the agency as a whole

We are seeking for qualified Pastrycooks / Bakers who passionate, enthusiastic, and responsible individuals.

Tasks and duties include the following:

* Preparing cakes, pastries, desserts, and pastry fillings.

* Glazing buns and pastries, and decorating cakes with cream and icing.
* Operating machines which roll and mould dough and cut biscuits.
* Emptying, cleaning and greasing baking trays, tins and other cooking equipment.
* Create new and exciting desserts to renew menus and engage the interest of customers.

Desirable qualifications and skills include:

* Relevant trade qualification or equivalent is a minimum requirement.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Pastry Cook / Bakers or Pastry Chef.
* Strong skills in the production of pastries, desserts and cakes – preferred.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to multi-task.
* Ability to work effectively and efficiently in a team environment.
* Have sound knowledge on all Pastry and bakery equipment including mixing and ovens.
* Strong work ethic and great attention to detail and creativity.
* Strong organizing and leadership skills.

Salary range: $80,000 – $90,000 per year

Smart Hill Constructions Pty Ltd 
(Reso Scaffold)
16 Prospect Place, Boronia VIC 3155

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson
$95,000 + superannuation

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems
•	Assist in resolving design documentation issues during construction and support continuous improvement of drafting processes

Assessment Criteria
•	A relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design, Architectural Technology, Architectural Interior Design or a closely related discipline, or relevant industry experience
•	At least three years of relevant experience preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation for residential and/or commercial building projects
•	Demonstrated proficiency using computer-aided drafting software such as AutoCAD, Revit or other comparable CAD/BIM platforms
•	Experience preparing and revising floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details and other technical documentation
•	Ability to interpret architectural concepts, engineering drawings and technical specifications and translate them into accurate construction documentation
•	Ability to communicate and coordinate drawings with architects, engineers, consultants and construction personnel throughout project delivery
•	Understanding of construction methods, building materials and document control procedures
•	Experience managing drawing revisions, version control and project documentation
•	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality technical drawings
•	Well-developed communication and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
•	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with all levels of stakeholders


How to apply:

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 August 2026 

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

About Us
Monte Construction PTY LTD is an Australian structural steel construction company dedicated to delivering high-quality steel fabrication and construction solutions across commercial, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. With a team of experienced engineers, detailers, and fabricators, Monte Construction specialises in the design, detailing, fabrication, and erection of structural steelwork for a diverse range of projects — from multi-storey commercial buildings and industrial facilities to bridges and civil structures. 

About the role
The Structural Steel Detailer transforms architectural and engineering plans into precise 3D models and 2D shop drawings. This role ensures all steelwork is detailed accurately for fabrication and erection. The position requires strict adherence to Australian Standards and project specifications. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between structural design and practical fabrication.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Generate detailed fabrication drawings, erection plans, and assembly drawings.
•	Produce accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cutting lists, and bolt lists for procurement.
•	Identify and resolve design clashes before fabrication commences.
•	Draft and submit Requests for Information (RFIs) to engineers or architects to resolve design discrepancies.
•	Liaise with the workshop to resolve fabrication queries and optimize detailing for manufacturing efficiency.
•	Work with site supervisors to ensure erection plans are clear and practical.
•	Ensure all detailing complies with the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Update models and drawings promptly to reflect design changes and site variations.
•	Maintain accurate records of drawing issues, revisions, and transmittals.
•	Self-check all drawings for dimensional accuracy and completeness prior to formal review.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive knowledge of AS 4100 (Steel structures), AS/NZS 1554 (Structural steel welding), and AS 5131 (Structural steelwork fabrication and erection).
•	High level of accuracy in drafting and mathematical calculations.
•	Ability to visualize complex 3D structures from 2D architectural and engineering plans.
•	Proven ability to manage multiple project deadlines simultaneously.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical coordination.
•	Proactive approach to identifying design flaws and proposing practical solutions.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Trade qualification or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000-$95,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

Location: Parramatta NSW 2150
Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 p/a
About the Business:
International College of Australia Pty Ltd trading as Western Sydney College is a dynamic Registered Training Organisation (RTO 45360) and CRICOS provider (03690M) dedicated to delivering practical, industry-focused vocational education and training. With a strong presence in Parramatta, the College offers nationally recognised qualifications under the Australian Qualifications Framework across a range of sectors including business, leadership and management, information technology, kitchen and hospitality management, community services, civil construction, and more. Committed to empowering international and domestic students through flexible blended learning, hands-on practical training, English language pathways, and comprehensive welfare support, Western Sydney College fosters a supportive, inclusive, and vibrant learning environment. The College values innovation, student success, strong industry connections, and compliance excellence, creating a collaborative workplace culture where staff contribute to shaping future leaders while enjoying opportunities for professional growth in a fast-paced educational setting.
About the Position:
The Office Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient daily operations of Western Sydney College’s Parramatta campus. This position is responsible for overseeing administrative functions, managing resources and teams, maintaining compliance with regulatory standards (including ASQA and CRICOS requirements), and supporting the delivery of high-quality vocational education services. Reporting to senior management, the Office Manager will drive operational improvements, coordinate campus activities, and contribute to the College’s commitment to student success and organisational excellence in the international education sector.
Key Responsibilities:
Contribute to planning, review, and improvement of office services and operational standards.
Allocate and manage human resources, workspace, and equipment for efficient campus operations.
Direct and supervise administrative teams, delegate responsibilities, and monitor staff performance.
Manage office budgets, financial accounts, invoicing, and documentation systems.
Liaise with departments, trainers, and external professionals to resolve operational issues.
Oversee sourcing, maintenance, and inventory of office equipment and supplies.
Ensure compliance with Occupational Health & Safety regulations and workplace procedures.
Ensure work processes comply with legislation, RTO policies, ASQA standards, and procedures.
Coordinate personnel activities including hiring, promotions, payroll, training, and supervision.
Manage campus scheduling, trainer allocations, and classroom coordination.
Support compliance preparation, internal audits, and reporting cycles.
Implement office policies, administrative procedures, and operational workflows.
Collaborate with senior management and stakeholders on operational planning.
Prepare operational and compliance reports and maintain administration systems.
Coordinate vendors and service providers for procurement and facility maintenance.
Monitor compliance deadlines, regulatory updates, and internal procedures.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
At least an AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma.
Minimum 1 year of experience in office administration.
Strong organisational and leadership skills with the ability to manage teams, budgets, and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with proven ability to liaise effectively with internal stakeholders, trainers, and external providers.
Sound knowledge of compliance requirements, preferably in the VET or international education sector (experience with PRISM enrolment system is highly regarded).
Proficiency in office management systems, financial documentation, scheduling tools, and Microsoft Office suite.
Commitment to Occupational Health & Safety and a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
